tweet.text:
how to start an ai services firm helping "boring" businesses grow on Main Street:

1 - pick one high ticket local niche

2 - create an asset pack like this, that shows the solution to ONE painful problem, with the math/receipts

3 - run a hyper local meta ads campaign talking through it

4 - say you're working with 2-3 in the area with an application flow, get a case study, film another video

5 - solve one painful problem you can attribute to more calls, more revenue, less headaches

6 - rinse and repeat. productize and solidify your workflows with each customer
